verdict.rationale: Onboarding speed is a fair question for a business banking and spend platform, but the evidence pack never documents how long account opening, KYB/KYC or full platform onboarding takes. The only time-bound claim is 'Full integration in under a sprint', which describes developer API/SDK integration for Instant Pay, not a founder onboarding onto the platform. That is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can fully onboard onto a new banking platform in about a week instead of months
